user: Is the deadline the same for every reason code?
answer:
No. Each reason code has its own window, counted in days from the transaction date:

| Reason code | Window |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 days |
| goods_not_received | 90 days |
| service_not_rendered | 90 days |
| duplicate_charge | 60 days |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 days |

A dispute filed after its window closes is not eligible.

For your two TechMart Online charges, the goods_not_received window would end:
- **TX-0402** (14 July 2026): about 12 October 2026
- **TX-0401** (20 July 2026): about 18 October 2026

If you were charged twice and use duplicate_charge (60 days), the window for TX-0402 would end around 12 September 2026. I don't have today's date in my tools, so I can't say how much time is left. The eligibility check gives the authoritative answer for each transaction and reason code, so tell me which one you want and I'll run it before anything is filed.
